package com.acme;
import javax.baja.sys.*;
public class BAcmeLogic extends BComponent {
  // unguarded: write on every decode
  @Override
  public void changed(Property p, Context cx) {
    if (p == in) setOut(getIn());
  }
  @Override
  public void added(Property p, Context cx) {
    setSize(getSize() + 1);
  }
  @Override
  public void removed(Property p, BValue old, Context cx) {
    super.removed(p, old, cx); setSize(getSize() - 1);
  }
  class Inner extends BComponent {
    public void changed(Property p, Context cx) {
      if (cx == null) return;
      if (!isRunning()) return;
      doWork();
    }
  }
}
-- src/com/acme/BAcmeClean.java --
package com.acme;
import javax.baja.sys.*;
public class BAcmeClean extends BComponent {
  public void changed(Property p, Context cx) {
    if (!isRunning()) return;
    setOut(getIn());
  }
  public void added(Property p, Context cx) {
    super.added(p, cx);
    if (!isRunning() || cx == Context.decoding) { return; }
    setSize(getSize() + 1);
  }
  public void removed(Property p, BValue old, Context cx) {
    if (isRunning()) { setSize(getSize() - 1); }
  }
  // only the super call: nothing acts
  public void changed2(Property p, Context cx) { setOut(1); }
  public void changed(String other) { setOut(2); }
  Object anon = new BComponent() {
    public void changed(Property p, Context cx) { setOut(3); }
  };
  /* public void changed(Property p, Context cx) { setOut(4); } */
  String s = "public void added(Property p, Context cx) { setOut(5); }";
}

package com.acme;
public class BAcmeSteady extends BComponent {
  public void changed(javax.baja.sys.Property p, javax.baja.sys.Context cx) {
    if (!Sys.atSteadyState()) return;
    setOut(getIn());
  }
  public void added(Property p, Context cx) {
    if (this.isRunning() && p == in) setOut(1);
  }
}
